accessMatrix.title: Library grant matrix
accessMatrix.intro: Tick which libraries each account may see. Ticking changes nothing on the server: preview the changes to see how many accounts and items they affect, and nothing is written until you confirm.
accessMatrix.adminsNote: Administrators see every library whatever is ticked; their ticks are kept and take effect if the account stops being an administrator. Disabled accounts are listed too.
accessMatrix.emptyHint: The matrix needs at least one library and one account.
accessMatrix.truncated: Only the first {n} accounts are listed. Use the account pages for the others.
accessMatrix.pending: {cells} changed grants for {users} accounts, not saved yet.
accessMatrix.tooMany: {n} accounts changed; one change may touch at most {max}. Discard some changes and apply them in batches.
accessMatrix.caption: Library grants by account
accessMatrix.applied: Access changed for {users} accounts: {shown} items became visible, {hidden} hidden.

apply.hint: Applying a template makes the selected accounts' library grants exactly the template's and replaces their ceiling, unrated handling, blocked tags and keywords. Item rules and time windows stay.
apply.unsaved: Preview or discard the unsaved grant changes first.
apply.noneSelected: Select accounts in the first column.

preview.countsNote: Visible and hidden count account × item pairs, judged now without network rules.
preview.noEffect: This change would not change anything.
preview.impact: Applying writes every change at once and records it in the audit log. Affected accounts see the result on their next request.

templates.title: Access templates
templates.intro: A template is a named set of library grants and restrictions. Apply it to accounts selected in the matrix above.
templates.emptyHint: Create one to give several accounts the same access in one step.
templates.name: Name
templates.nameHint: Unique, ignoring case; at most 64 characters.
templates.nameTaken: Another template already has this name.
templates.invalid: The server cannot use this template. Check the name and the lists.
templates.librariesHint: Accounts receive exactly these libraries; others are removed.
templates.saveNote: Saving a template changes no account; accounts change only when it is applied.
templates.deletePrompt: Accounts it was applied to keep their access.
